svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 560 mm lengths of 25 x 40 x 1.5 mm tube; square and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tunnel for the torque tube, at mid-length (280 mm from each end):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a notch 25.5 mm long and 25.25 mm deep, cut from one 25 mm face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the face that goes on the panel) down through both 40 mm sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw the two sides, chain drill and file the floor flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push a 25 mm tube offcut through the tunnel: it must slide, not rock.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit plastic end caps in both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the notched face is bonded to the back of the backing panel with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: structural silicone, the rib centre line 227.5 mm from the panel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line and its ends 20 mm in from the panel edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The torque tube runs through both tunnels and touches the panel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both tunnels line up when the ribs lie side by side.
